name: Pontoon
description: Pontoon is the British version of Twenty-one; players buy or twist cards aiming for 21 or less, beating the banker without going bust.

content.text: Pontoon is the British version of Twenty-one; players buy or twist cards aiming for 21 or less, beating the banker without going bust.

Country/Region of Origin: United Kingdom
Time Period: Early 1900s (name pontoon from WWI); vingt-un from late 18th century in France and Britain
Historical Development: British domestic version of Twenty-one; name from French vingt-et-un; first rules in Britain 1800
Cultural Significance: Popular family game in Britain; 3rd most popular card game in Britain (1981) after Rummy and Whist

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Table space

Cards per Player: Varies by player count
Dealing Pattern: Clockwise
